interest: Tracks 1934 Korean labor migration to Japan.
overview: Docket (1934) indexes four reports on Korean labor migration to Japan and Japanese restrictions.

people.name: John Farr Simmons
people.role: Chief, Visa Division, Department of State

people.name: John M. Allison
people.role: Foreign Service Officer, American Embassy, Tokyo

subfiles.about: A State Department docket sheet listing four despatches and reports from 1934 concerning Korean immigration and labor movements into Japan.
subfiles.summary: Indexes four 1934 items on Korean migration to Japan: Langdon's despatch, a Visa Division memo with press and labor data, and Allison's Reports 143 and 148 on migration trends and restrictions.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Immigration to Japan from Chosen
